symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1543 (ako/mxcli#1441): a Log message activity's 'Include latest stack trace' had no MDL spelling — `LOG ERROR NODE 'X' 'failed' WITH STACKTRACE;` was a parse error (`mismatched input 'stacktrace' expecting '('`), so every log written through MDL stored IncludeLatestStackTrace = false and describe dropped a Studio Pro-ticked box on the round trip
cause: half-wired: the model field (IncludeLastStackTrace), the modelsdk writer and the reader all carried it since the engine rewrite, but no grammar slot, AST field, builder assignment or describe clause existed, and the --mcp writer omitted it
file: mdl/grammar/MDLLexer.g4 (STACKTRACE), mdl/grammar/domains/MDLMicroflow.g4 (logStackTrace), MDLSettings.g4 (keyword rule), mdl/visitor/visitor_microflow_actions.go, mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_calls.go, mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_format_action.go, mdl/backend/mcp/microflow.go
fix: `log … [with ({1} = …)] with stacktrace` after the template parameters; `WITH (` vs `WITH STACKTRACE` is decided on the second token. STACKTRACE is in the keyword rule so `$latestError/Stacktrace` (System.Error's attribute) still parses. Describe prints it only when ticked (unticked is the default an absent clause builds), so existing describe output is unchanged
test: mdl/executor/issue1543_log_stacktrace_test.go (parse→build, describe→reparse, $latestError/Stacktrace); mdl/backend/mcp/microflow_test.go. Control: with only the AST field the test failed with the reported parse error; with grammar but no builder line, IncludeLatestStackTrace = false. Real run on 11.12.4: mx check 0 errors with the flag in a microflow and a nanoflow; control nanoflow with an undefined template variable reports CE0109 on that Log message activity, so the check does inspect it
insight: Grep the model struct's field writers before designing syntax: the backend already round-tripped the flag, so the gap was only the language surface and the --mcp map, which turns a 'feature' into five small wiring edits. Version facts: the Model SDK's LogMessageAction.versionInfo has no entry for includeLatestStackTrace (present in every supported version), so no gate. A new keyword next to a template clause needs a test that the System attribute of the same name still parses in expressions. `describe … with handles` now prints handles containing `with stacktrace`, which an alter target cannot spell (alterFlowTarget stops at WITH — pre-existing for `with ({1} = …)` and `with events`); `*` covers it
